newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Property construction in Singapore up in 3rd qtr.
newsitem.headline: Property construction in Singapore up in 3rd qtr.

text.p: Private residential units under construction in Singapore in the third quarter of 1996 rose 4.8 percent to 41,255 units from the previous quarter, the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Friday.

The URA said in its quarterly release on potential supply and occupancy that the number of uncompleted private homes with sale licenses and building plan approvals increased by 7.8 percent to 31,277 units. Of these, 8,882 units were unsold at the end of the third quarter.
The occupancy rate of new homes was 94.2 percent, up 0.4 percent from the second quarter.
Gross office space under construction increased by 7.2 percent to 1.079 million square metres while office occupancy edged up 0.7 percentage point to 92.0 percent.
The URA said gross factory space under construction rose 10 percent to 3.752 million square metres but gross shop and warehouse space under construction slipped.
